articles.summary: Reinforces Ongoing Commitment to Delivering Value to Stockholders CDW Corporation (Nasdaq: CDW) announced today that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.680 per common share to be paid on December 10, 2026, to all stockholders of record as of the close of business on November 25, 2026. This amount represents approximately an 8 percent increase over last year's dividend and is aligned with the target of 25 percent of the trailing-twelve-month Non-GAAP net income through September 30, 2026. "Dividends represent an important component of our capital allocation priorities, along with share repurchases, strategic MA, and managing our capital structure," said Albert J. Miralles, chief financial officer, CDW. "This increase reflects our confidence in CDW’s future earnings power and cash flow generation. articles.summary: CDW Corporation (Nasdaq: CDW) today announced that Christine A. Leahy, chair and chief executive officer, and Albert J. Miralles, chief financial officer and executive vice president, enterprise business operations, CDW, will participate in a question and answer session at the UBS Global Technology and AI Conference to be held in Scottsdale, Arizona on Tuesday, December 1, 2026, at 11:55 a.m. CT/ 10:55 a.m. MT. The presentation will be webcast live on investor.CDW.com . An archived copy of the webcast will be available on the same website for 180 days following the completion of the event. About CDW CDW Corporation (Nasdaq: CDW) is the strategic end-to-end technology partner that cuts through complexity to turn customer ambition into outcomes.
